research_question: Does XoXLang prevent or expose unjustified definitive decisions and silent uncertainty loss without unacceptable developer comprehension penalty?

perfect_implementation_baseline.conclusion: Feasibility demonstrated across all paradigms; zero baseline differentiation.

fairness_adjusted_mutations.note: Under dynamic runtime execution, Structured Python rejects only MUT-02 via custom __bool__; additional protection attributable to optional static type checking (e.g. mypy) must be reported separately as a static-analysis layer rather than a dynamic runtime guarantee.

safe_layer_containment.governance_mechanism: WorldStateAuthority 4-tuple resolution verification (ProvenanceSet, OperationType, WorldStateID, FallbackPolicyIdentity)

native_xox_guarantees: Mandatory xen branch on ternary conditions
Anti-coercion type error on truthiness evaluation
Explicit unwrap_or for policy decision separation
Distinction between conflict and missing evidence (MUT-09) enforced by finite-world classifier
host_boundary_limitations: External context freshness detection requires host ingress signal (MUT-05); XoX enforces invalidation fail-closed once signaled via WorldStateID
negative_results: Formal statistical equivalence between XoXLang and Python Structured remains unproven (no predeclared equivalence margin)
Human-only cohort (N=5 per condition) is underpowered for standalone strong statistical inference
FFI boundaries remain vulnerable to external truthiness coercion if unwrap is misused
Learning overhead requires initial 1-page primer review (3 clarifications recorded across 15 participants)
validated_claims: XoXLang eliminates silent uncertainty loss in 6 out of 7 plausible accidental mutation patterns
XoXLang showed significantly fewer participant-level unsafe modifications than Classic Python (0/15 vs 8/15, Fisher exact p = 0.0022)
On nine discriminating tasks, XoXLang achieved a modest but statistically detectable higher participant score than Structured Python (18.00/18 vs 17.27/18, Mann-Whitney U p = 0.0035)
Minimal 1-page primer is sufficient for full semantic comprehension without internal design history
unsupported_claims: Universal superiority over all programming languages
Proof of real-world human software safety in long-term production
Proof that Python cannot achieve high safety via strict typing and custom dunder methods
Proof of zero real-world failure risk from 0 observed sample failures
Statistical proof of formal equivalence/parity with Python Structured (no predeclared equivalence margin)

statistical_validity_reanalysis.pseudoreplication_audit: Detected and corrected in inferential analysis; repeated task observations within participants are treated as clustered/repeated measures rather than independent samples.

zero_observed_xox_failures_uncertainty.interpretation: Observed zero failures does not imply zero true risk; true underlying failure probability is bounded below ~20.4% at 95% confidence.

humans.interpretation: Direction is consistent with pooled results, but cohort is underpowered for strong standalone significance claims.

agents.interpretation: Direction is consistent with the human cohort and pooled analysis.
